title: Knowledge Wiki employment context and hiring acceptance
objective: Help Jamie secure a well-matched role quickly without sacrificing truth, privacy, collective credit, human authority, or one-year mutual fit.
scoring: No blended score. Every hard gate reports separately; external outcomes and human authority remain separate.
stop_conditions: no priority-zero gap remains for the selected target
the next change adds more burden than signal
a named human decision is required
no improvement after two bounded cycles
outward action or deadline takes priority

evals.title: One authority model and Private Source Vault boundary
pass_criteria: One docs/knowledge-bank compatibility root remains
No raw communications or private locators enter Git
Protected channels use opaque metadata only

evals.title: Six official and fresh priority opportunity records
pass_criteria: All Tier 1 records exist
Official employer pages are canonical
Live records have bounded 48-72 hour reverification windows

evals.title: Stable requirements, hard screens, and source discrepancies
pass_criteria: Requirements have stable IDs
Hard screens remain distinct
OTI public-page and Internal-CSV discrepancy remains visible

evals.title: Role, trajectory, and source-channel coverage
pass_criteria: Every role has a generated coverage matrix
Career trajectory reports strengths and limits
Source channels report gaps and public-use boundaries

evals.title: Title-blind opportunity discovery with negative controls
pass_criteria: Known-good Top-6 recall is 100 percent
Precision is 100 percent
Hard-screen, closed, and below-floor controls are rejected

evals.title: Hiring evaluator and Wiki gap resolver separation
pass_criteria: Evaluator receives public portfolio and public context only
Gap resolver runs after the hiring report
Hidden Wiki evidence cannot leak into evaluator context

evals.title: Sourced reader profiles and honest simulation labels
pass_criteria: Named profiles have public sources
Every named profile has the full non-endorsement disclaimer
Development and holdout readers do not overlap

evals.title: Exact candidate, context, and independent judgment binding
pass_criteria: Development and holdout reports match the candidate fingerprint
Snapshot, role, reader, and prompt hashes are retained
Judge is independent from optimizer

evals.title: Role-specific public hiring acceptance
pass_criteria: Professional category and target relevance are understood quickly
Critical requirements are assessed from visible evidence only
The report retains missing positive evidence and uncertainty

evals.title: One-year mutual-fit advisory panel
pass_criteria: Herminia lens examines working identity
Claudio lens examines selection risk
Amy lens examines authority, learning, and psychological safety

evals.title: Chad lens and Jamie voice
pass_criteria: Actor, action, result, and boundary are legible
The strongest sentence arrives quickly
Prose remains warm, specific, and restrained

evals.title: Human authority and outward action remain open
pass_criteria: Reports do not claim Jamie approval or employer outcome
Application and release actions remain human
The system explicitly yields to a live deadline
